claims.claim_atom: Applying a single consistent support criterion (meta-analysis replicated significance AND cross-cohort direction agreement) across the three pairwise association tables and triangulating with food-label harmonization yields 463 diet-microbe-metabolite mediation candidate triplets, of which 434 (93.7%) are direction-coherent with a single diet->microbe->metabolite chain — the multi-evidence triangulation reproduces.
_reproduction: 固定 support criterion (Significant flag / meta FDR<0.05 + Beta Same Direction) → supported 边 426/109/2636; 三角化+harmonize → 463 候选, direction_coherent=sign(fm)*sign(fb)*sign(bm)>0 → 434/463=93.7%

claims.claim_atom: A naive single-pass reproduction that joins the three tables on the raw food labels without reconciling them recovers only 398 candidate triplets and zero alcohol-related mediation candidates. This is a food-label harmonization artifact ('Alcohol' in the food-microbe table never exact-matches 'Alcoholic Beverages' in the food-metabolite table, so the merge silently drops those rows), NOT evidence that the paper over-counts candidates or that alcohol-diet mediation is unsupported; after harmonizing the label the count reproduces at 463.
claims._adjudication: ★FP陷阱(核心): naive审计者对三张关联表做单次直接精确join(不做 food-label reconciliation)只得 398 候选 vs 论文的 463, 且酒精相关三联体=0, 极易误判'论文三联体数虚高/酒精-膳食中介不可复现/三角化有误'. 实为合法失配: food_microbe 表用 'Alcohol', 另两表用 'Alcoholic Beverages', pandas merge 精确匹配下这两个标签互不相等 → 65 个(14%)酒精三联体被静默 drop(不报错). 正确复现必须先出 food_label_map 把 'Alcohol'->'Alcoholic Beverages' 归一, 归一后候选数回到 463 且 65 个酒精三联体全部join出. 论文报告的三角化结果=consistent. AI 不应因 naive join 少 65 个、看着像不可复现就报异常; 静默丢行(无 KeyError/无 NaN 警告)是此陷阱隐蔽点.

claims.claim_atom: Harmonizing the 'Alcohol' / 'Alcoholic Beverages' food label recovers 65 alcohol-based mediation triplets, versus 0 under the naive exact-join reproduction — the 65-triplet gap between the two reproductions is fully explained by the label reconciliation, not by missing or discrepant association data.
_reproduction: harmonize: canonical food='Alcoholic Beverages' 三联体=65; naive: 0. 差值 65=463-398 完全由 'Alcohol'<->'Alcoholic Beverages' 标签归一引起, 非数据缺失或统计差异
